newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIUM TO FIGHT TAX FRAUD WITH MORE INFO ON SPEND.
newsitem.headline: BELGIUM TO FIGHT TAX FRAUD WITH MORE INFO ON SPEND.

text.p: To fight widespread tax fraud in the country, Belgium is stepping up a campaign to inform its people about what the state does with their cash.

Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said in a parliamentary answer that he would commission a specialist agency to improve a brochure on the use of government revenues tax payers get with their tax returns so as to boost Belgians' "poor tax morale".
A recent newspaper poll found that 61.4 percent of Belgians saw few objections to avoiding tax, but also that 57.4 percent felt the state did not tell them where tax payments were going.
"Too many examples of tax payers' money being wasted" and increasing individualism had fostered those attitudes, he said.
